value.author: harness:codex
value.text:
Draft passing-questionnaire evidence matrix for maintainer confirmation and submission:
- Basics=yes: README describes pm-cli, npm/GitHub provide stable obtain URLs, GitHub Issues provides feedback, CONTRIBUTING documents PRs and acceptance gates, MIT LICENSE is OSI-compatible.
- Change control=yes: public git history, date-based unique versions, generated CHANGELOG, GitHub releases, npm artifacts, and release verification are public.
- Documentation=yes: README quickstart, docs index, command help/contracts, SDK/extension guides, architecture, testing, contribution, code of conduct, and security policy are linked.
- Defect/security reporting=yes after this bundle: public issue tracker for normal defects; GitHub private vulnerability reporting URL, response targets, coordinated disclosure, scope, and safe harbor in SECURITY.md.
- Build/quality=yes: Node and pnpm prerequisites, reproducible install/build commands, TypeScript strict typecheck, ESLint, zero-clone jscpd, CodeFactor-calibrated static gate, ShellCheck/PSScriptAnalyzer/actionlint, CodeQL/Semgrep/Trivy/TruffleHog, and warnings-as-errors CI.
- Tests=yes: public Vitest suite, required 100% statements/branches/functions/lines, cross-platform/runtime/installed-package lanes, and fast-check property fuzzing of four trust boundaries on every PR.
- Dependencies=yes: lockfile, Dependabot, pnpm audit, pinned GitHub Actions, engine-aware upgrade dispositions, and published-package consumer verification.
- Secure development=yes based on repository evidence: private reports are isolated, secrets are scanned/redacted, extension trust boundaries are documented, telemetry is redacted, mutations/history are integrity checked, and releases use provenance-aware npm/GitHub workflows.
- Crypto=standard-library only: SHA-256 hashing and platform/package cryptographic primitives are not custom cryptographic protocols; maintainer should confirm the questionnaire N/A/yes selections.
- Maintainer confirmations required before submission: project is actively maintained; all MUST answers remain accurate; SHOULD exceptions have truthful justifications; no known undisclosed vulnerability contradicts an answer; private vulnerability reporting is enabled; submitter is authorized to attest for unbraind.
- After bestpractices.dev returns a project id/status, record the public URL here and add the official badge to README only when the service reports in-progress or passing as appropriate.
